checks.text: The page shows the heading "Simon Says Game", the text "Press Start to begin", and the score line "Score: 0".
Typing "42" in the field labelled "Seed" and clicking the button "Start" plays a sequence of exactly 4 pads; the score line reads "Score: 0" and the pads become enabled for input.

With Seed "42", the first pad of the sequence is the pad labelled "Red"; clicking "Red" then "Blue" then "Green" then "Yellow" in that order advances the score line to "Score: 1" and plays a sequence of exactly 5 pads.
With Seed "42", clicking the pad labelled "Blue" as the first input (when the sequence starts with "Red") shows the message "Wrong pad" and the score line remains "Score: 0".
After reaching "Score: 1", clicking the button "Restart" resets the score line to "Score: 0", clears the message, and shows "Press Start to begin".
With Seed "42", completing the first sequence (Score: 1) and then completing the second sequence of 5 pads (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Red) advances the score line to "Score: 2".

The tab labelled "History" shows a table with the header "Best Score"; after achieving "Score: 2" in a round with Seed "42" and switching to the tab labelled "History", the table contains a row with "42" and "2".
Clicking the button "Copy best" in the tab labelled "History" shows the toast text "Best score copied" and the clipboard contains "Best score: 2".
Reload keeps the best score: after achieving "Score: 2" with Seed "42", reloading the page still shows "Best Score: 2" in the tab labelled "History".
